abstract: Streaming Sortformer introduced an arrival-order speaker cache to maintain speaker identities across chunks in end-to-end streaming speaker diarization, with a single model supporting configurable latency profiles spanning offline operation to ultra-low-latency streaming. Nemotron 3 Diarization addresses the original model's four-speaker limitation by extending support to eight speakers while improving both accuracy and computational efficiency. The previous FastConformer-Transformer stack is streamlined into a pure Transformer encoder. A learned upsampling layer then maps the encoder's coarse 80-ms representations to 10-ms resolution, enabling fine-grained predictions. Training leverages large-scale simulated mixtures and adds activity and phantom-speaker losses to the standard Sortformer objectives. Despite doubling speaker capacity over its predecessor, the new architecture reduces training memory by a factor of 2.8, makes training $2.2\times$ faster, and delivers up to $6.4\times$ higher inference throughput. Nemotron 3 Diarization establishes a new state of the art in DER on DIHARD III and CALLHOME. When used to condition DiCoW, it also achieves state-of-the-art tcpWER on the single-microphone conditions of AMI and NOTSOFAR-1. Training code is open source, and model weights are released under the permissive OpenMDW-1.1 license.

oneSentenceThesis: 针对流式说话人日志要在分块、低延迟下保持身份、支持更多说话人和更精细边界的问题，该工作用纯 Transformer 编码器加学习上采样、八说话人到达序缓存与活动和幻影辅助损失，在 DIHARD III 和 CALLHOME 等集上降低 DER 并在 AMI 和 NOTSOFAR-1 上下游转写上降低 tcpWER，同时减少训练内存和提高推理吞吐。
originalTitle: Nemotron 3 Diarization: Advancing the Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier in Streaming Speaker Diarization
readerTitle: Nemotron 3 Diarization：把流式说话人日志推到八人、10 毫秒与更高吞吐
